races.paceDynamic: Esherann holds the clearest early speed and should make the running without immediate pressure, setting a sustainable tempo over this seven furlongs. The majority of runners adopt prominent or hold-up tactics, meaning the pace will likely be honest but not fierce through the early stages. With so many waiting in behind, the race should develop into a sprint finish where positioning and timing become crucial. This setup strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and strike in the final furlong, rather than hold-up horses who may struggle to weave through traffic in a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Esherann sets an uncontested lead and the field settles behind
scenarios.body: The pace remains comfortable until the final quarter-mile when multiple challengers fan out for home. Prominent runners with tactical speed can position perfectly to strike when it matters, avoiding the traffic problems that will ensnare hold-up horses in this big field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Increased Early Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Esherann from the start
scenarios.body: The pace quickens as several horses vie for position early, setting up a more searching test. This scenario plays into the hands of proven stayers among the prominent group who can handle the stronger gallop and still have enough left for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes pedestrian throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the furlong pole, allowing the best finishers to overcome traffic concerns. Patient jockeys on hold-up horses can time their runs to perfection when the field comes back to them late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Esherann gets an easy lead and no serious challengers emerge
scenarios.body: The leader maintains control throughout while the field fails to organize an effective pursuit. This rare outcome requires the pace-setter to have an exceptional day while others underperform or get caught in trouble.

Count Palatine's 3lb apprentice claim could prove decisive in a tight finish - watch for late surge

races.paceDynamic: Dandana is the clear early leader with her prominent style and class edge, likely to dictate from the front without serious pressure in the opening stages. The large field contains mostly prominent runners like Rhyme Dust, Lady Roxby, and Splish Splash who will sit just off the pace, while the hold-up pair Beaujolais Nouveau and Shallow will need luck from the back. This creates a moderate tempo with the winner likely coming from the prominent group tracking Dandana, as the sprint finish will suit those positioned handy rather than hold-up horses getting swamped in a big field. The race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and quicken, with front-runners also holding chances if the tempo stays sustainable.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dandana Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Dandana gets an uncontested lead and maintains her rhythm
scenarios.body: She dictates on her own terms with James Doyle able to quicken when ready, making it hard for the field to peg back her class advantage. The long absence becomes irrelevant as she controls the race from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Dandana and create a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased pace will suit the classier prominent runners who can sustain the tempo, with Rhyme Dust's consistent 6f form and Splish Splash's tactical speed becoming key assets. Hold-up horses still struggle to make up the ground in a competitive finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint and gaps appear in the straight
scenarios.body: Beaujolais Nouveau's recent win and Shallow's strong finishing kick become decisive factors as they sweep past a faltering field. The big field creates the traffic problems they need others to encounter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lower-Rated Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly run to suit and the weights tell
scenarios.body: Cool Molly's light weight and recent form, or Bintaryana's upward trajectory, allows them to capitalize when the higher-rated horses compromise each other. The 3-year-olds get their conditions perfectly.

races.paceDynamic: Astro King is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 16-runner handicap and will dictate terms from the start. With most of the field (Antipodes, Rathgar, Fantasy Believer, Love Beach, Spioradalta, City Of Delight) preferring prominent positions, there will be significant early crowding behind Astro King as horses jostle for position. The hold-up horses (Wahdan, Castle Stuart, Per Contra, Dark Moon Rising) will be relegated to the back as the prominent brigade creates a wall of horses through the middle portion of the race. This race shape heavily favours front-runners and early prominent horses who can secure good positions before the inevitable late-race traffic problems develop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Astro King Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Astro King gets an uncontested lead through steady fractions.
scenarios.body: He can kick clear approaching the straight while the prominent horses behind get tangled up in traffic. His superior rating and tactical advantage from the front proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures the ideal tracking position behind Astro King.
scenarios.body: They can pounce when Astro King weakens in the final furlong, avoiding the traffic chaos further back. The winner comes from the early prominent group with clear running.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and the hold-up horses get perfect splits in the straight.
scenarios.body: Wahdan or Castle Stuart can unleash a powerful late run through gaps that open up. The early speed horses tire and create opportunities for patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Carnage Special
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses create a wall and no clear gaps appear in the straight.
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse like Dark Moon Rising gets the dream run up the rail or Astro King simply keeps going. Chaos behind allows an unlikely winner to emerge from the mayhem.

races.paceDynamic: Schrodinger's Cat is the only confirmed front runner and will have an easy lead with the prominent runners Forest Phoenix, Empress Olivia, Houndhill, Simba's Pride, Adalida and I'm Dan Dare likely settling just behind. With most of the field preferring hold-up tactics, there's minimal early pressure which creates a moderate, sustainable gallop. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent horses who can track the leader closely and the hold-up horses who benefit from the steady tempo, making life difficult for Schrodinger's Cat to sustain his advantage alone on the front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle nicely behind Schrodinger's Cat and time their challenges perfectly
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows trackers like Forest Phoenix, Simba's Pride and Adalida to position ideally and strike with superior finishing kicks. Schrodinger's Cat's solo lead becomes a liability when the quality horses behind unleash coordinated challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays genuinely steady throughout allowing maximum closing opportunities
scenarios.body: The large hold-up contingent including Ambishio, Angel Numbers and Straight Ahead get perfect race conditions with strong galloping room. Superior class tells as they sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong with Ambishio's OR79 rating proving decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Schrodinger's Cat gets easy fractions early and the field leaves their runs too late
scenarios.body: His recent consistent form at this trip proves crucial as he builds an unassailable lead while the prominent horses fail to apply enough pressure. The hold-up horses find too much ground to make up despite the moderate tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow creating a messy sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure speed test over the final 2f where position becomes everything and several horses get hampered. Fresh horses with tactical speed like Rotokura Belle and those drawn well can capitalize on the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Say What You See will lead with minimal early pressure in this 20-runner handicap, creating a sustainable gallop through the early stages. The prominent group of Harry The Rogue, Dovey Moon, Naples, and Mao Shang Wong will track the leader without applying serious pressure, allowing the pace to develop steadily. With most of the field holding back - including quality hold-up horses like Epictetus, Northwest Passage, Mafting, and Glistening Nights - the race sets up for a sustained drive from halfway home. This tactical shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate as expected with Say What You See leading unchallenged.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will suit horses positioned in rear who can unleash finishing kicks, with the large field providing cover and the steady tempo preserving stamina for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Harry The Rogue or Dovey Moon apply more pressure to Say What You See than anticipated.
scenarios.body: A stronger early gallop will advantage those positioned handy who can respond to pace changes without needing to make up significant ground, allowing them to strike before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Say What You See gets uncontested fractions and the field fails to organize a coherent challenge.
scenarios.body: The leader will have too much in reserve for the finish, staying on strongly while the pursuing pack struggles to make up ground despite the seemingly moderate pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling with multiple horses tracking the leader closely.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any running style can prevail, with positions and luck in running becoming more important than tactical profiles.
